channel.title: Financial Regulation Hub · SEBI
channel.description: New and amended rules from Securities and Exchange Board of India, as covered by the Financial Regulation Hub.

item.title: SEBI: Simplification of client on-boarding and rationalisation of risk management framework at KYC Registration Agencies
item.description:
SEBI · Circular

Effective 2026-12-24.

Who it covers: All SEBI-registered intermediaries that on-board clients, and KYC Registration Agencies.

  • Common supplementary client information (such as income range, FATCA/CRS details, PEP status and occupation) is centralised at the KRA, along with CKYC ID, DIGIPIN and the expiry date of the officially valid document.
  • Intermediaries upload the specified KYC information to the KRA within three working days of completing KYC.
  • In force from 24-12-2026; KRAs issue an operating procedure within 30 days.

Official source

item.title: SEBI: FATCA and CRS reporting revised under the Income-Tax Act, 2025 and Income-Tax Rules, 2026
item.description:
SEBI · Circular

Effective 2026-11-11.

Who it covers: Registered intermediaries that are Reporting Financial Institutions.

  • Reporting and due diligence now follow s. 508 of the Income-Tax Act, 2025 and rules 238 to 240 and Form 166 of the Income-Tax Rules, 2026.
  • Self-certification, controlling person and account classification systems must capture the new fields; FATCA/CRS certifications are uploaded to the KRA.

Official source

item.title: SEBI: SEBI (Settlement of Administrative and Civil Proceedings) Regulations, 2026 in force
item.description:
SEBI · Regulations · SEBI/LAD-DOP/2026/318

Effective 2026-11-07.

Who it covers: Anyone facing or likely to face SEBI proceedings.

  • Replace the Settlement Proceedings Regulations, 2018.
  • Settlement notices before a show cause notice, a formula-based settlement amount, and fast track settlement for delayed or wrong-format disclosures.
  • Applications within 90 days of a show cause notice; pending cases not settled under the 2018 rules may apply within 90 days at a 20% higher amount.

Official source

item.title: SEBI: Consultation paper: AML/CFT certification for Principal Officers of intermediaries
item.description:
SEBI · Consultation paper

Who it covers: All intermediaries registered under s. 12 of the SEBI Act.

  • Proposes a mandatory AML/CFT certification for the Principal Officer responsible for PMLA compliance.
  • No rule has changed yet.

Official source

item.title: SEBI: Framework for net settlement of funds for mutual fund cash market transactions
item.description:
SEBI · Circular

Effective 2027-04-01.

Who it covers: Mutual funds, custodians, stock brokers and clearing corporations.

  • Funds for outright transactions in the cash segment may be settled net at the level of each scheme; securities still settle gross.
  • No netting across schemes. In force from 01-04-2027.

Official source

item.title: SEBI: Review of the framework for Accredited Investors
item.description:
SEBI · Circular

Effective 2026-11-05.

Who it covers: AIF managers, SIF AMCs and portfolio managers, and their investors.

  • Managers may determine and record an investor's accredited status themselves, valid for three years and recognised across the same group.
  • Securities market exposure qualifies: at least Rs 5 crore for individuals, HUFs, family trusts and sole proprietorships, and Rs 20 crore for bodies corporate and other trusts.

Official source

item.title: SEBI: Review of KYC process for individual Person Resident Outside India clients
item.description:
SEBI · Circular

Effective 2026-12-03.

Who it covers: Intermediaries on-boarding NRI, OCI and foreign national individual clients.

  • Digital KYC is allowed for individual clients located in FATF-compliant countries, without being in India.
  • Intermediaries may rely on KYC by another SEBI or financial sector regulated entity through KRA or CKYCRR records.

Official source

item.title: SEBI: Extension of timeline for digital accessibility compliance
item.description:
SEBI · Circular

Effective 2026-10-30.

Who it covers: All SEBI regulated entities.

  • Appointment of an accessibility auditor, the accessibility audit of digital platforms and fixing its findings are extended to 31-01-2027.

Official source

item.title: SEBI: Further extension for debenture trustees to move non-SEBI activities to separate business units
item.description:
SEBI · Circular

Effective 2026-10-27.

Who it covers: Debenture trustees.

  • The deadline to comply with regulation 9C and the separate business unit framework moves to 27-04-2027 while an expert group reviews it.

Official source

item.title: SEBI: Closing Auction Session, market timings and settlement methodology for derivatives
item.description:
SEBI · Circular

Effective 2026-12-07.

Who it covers: Stock exchanges, clearing corporations and stock brokers.

  • Changes to the closing auction session, market timings and the settlement price method for derivatives; parts take effect from 07-12-2026.

Official source

item.title: SEBI: SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) (Third Amendment) Regulations, 2026
item.description:
SEBI · Amendment Regulations · SEBI/LAD-DOP/2026/329

Effective 2026-10-14.

Who it covers: Entities that list non-convertible debt securities.

  • Regulation 62A(1) substituted: an entity whose non-convertible debt securities are listed on or after 14-10-2026 must list all non-convertible debt securities it issues after that listing.
  • Regulation 62A(2) and (3) omitted.

Official source

item.title: SEBI: SEBI (Alternative Investment Funds) (Third Amendment) Regulations, 2026
item.description:
SEBI · Amendment Regulations · SEBI/LAD-NRO/GN/2026/326

Effective 2026-10-14.

Who it covers: AIFs, their managers and investors.

  • Accredited investors may now be accredited by a specified SEBI-registered entity, and securities market exposure becomes a qualifying test.
  • Regulation 25 on dispute resolution between investors and the AIF or manager is substituted.

Official source

item.title: SEBI: Consultation paper: review of ICDR provisions on SME IPOs
item.description:
SEBI · Consultation paper

Who it covers: SME issuers and merchant bankers.

  • Working group recommendations to revise the SME IPO framework.
  • No rule has changed yet.

Official source

item.title: SEBI: Consultation paper: monitoring and disclosure of utilisation of issue proceeds (LODR review)
item.description:
SEBI · Consultation paper

Who it covers: Listed entities raising funds.

  • Working group recommendations on monitoring agency reports and disclosure of how issue proceeds are used.
  • No rule has changed yet.

Official source

item.title: SEBI: SEBI (Intermediaries) (Second Amendment) Regulations, 2026: common advertisement code
item.description:
SEBI · Amendment Regulations · SEBI/LAD-NRO/GN/2026/323

Who it covers: Regulated entities that advertise, including AMCs, stock brokers and AIF managers.

  • New Chapter IIID sets a common advertisement code, including rules on celebrity endorsements and influencers.
  • In force 180 days after publication on 09-10-2026. The MF Regulations' own advertisement schedule is removed by a matching amendment.

Official source

item.title: SEBI: SEBI (Portfolio Managers) Regulations, 2026
item.description:
SEBI · Regulations

Effective 2027-04-01.

Who it covers: Portfolio managers, including AMCs that offer portfolio management services.

  • New regulations replace the Portfolio Managers Regulations, 2020 from 01-04-2027.

Official source

item.title: SEBI: No mandatory merchant banker for certain private placements of debt by listed regulated issuers
item.description:
SEBI · Circular

Effective 2026-10-07.

Who it covers: Listed issuers regulated by SEBI, RBI, IRDAI or PFRDA issuing debt of Rs 10,000 face value on private placement.

  • Such issuers may skip the merchant banker if they meet all the conditions, including at least one year of listing and no pending fines.

Official source

item.title: SEBI: More ISINs for privately placed debt securities
item.description:
SEBI · Circular

Effective 2026-10-07.

Who it covers: Issuers of privately placed debt securities.

  • Up to 17 ISINs may mature in a financial year (12 plain vanilla, 5 structured and similar), plus six for capital gains bonds, with extra ISINs for large issuers.

Official source

item.title: SEBI: Credit Risk-o-Meter for debt securities
item.description:
SEBI · Circular

Effective 2026-11-21.

Who it covers: Issuers of debt securities and online bond platform providers.

  • A colour-coded Credit Risk-o-Meter becomes mandatory in offer documents, abridged prospectuses, private placement memoranda, issuer advertisements and online bond platforms.
  • In force 45 days after issue.

Official source

item.title: SEBI: Investor awareness messages on stock brokers' websites and apps (Project Jagrook)
item.description:
SEBI · Circular

Effective 2026-11-01.

Who it covers: Stock brokers.

  • From 01-11-2026, investor awareness messages shared by SEBI go on the landing page of brokers' websites, and alternate with risk disclosures on trading apps.

Official source

item.title: SEBI: Master Circular for Debenture Trustees
item.description:
SEBI · Master Circular

Effective 2026-09-28.

Who it covers: Debenture trustees and issuers of listed debt.

  • Consolidates the circulars for debenture trustees.

Official source

item.title: SEBI: More time for older angel funds to move to accredited investors only
item.description:
SEBI · Circular

Effective 2026-09-07.

Who it covers: Angel funds registered on or before 10-09-2025.

  • The accredited-investor-only deadline moves from 08-09-2026 to 31-03-2027; up to 200 non-accredited investors may be offered deals until then.

Official source
